title: Lionfish winners lionized
content: The winners of GurneyJourney's "Lionfish Shampoo" contest were featured in the December issue ofImagineFXmagazine.Congratulations,Candice Broersma,Katie Small, andMichelle Spalding, and thanks to everyone who entered.Previously on GurneyJourney:Lionfish Shampoo Contest announced.and see the many excellent solutions in the postLionfish Contest Results.
